description: CORD v2 validation records in cord_validation_100_seed17 that cord_validation_50_seed17 does not use; untouched during tuning.

shared_fields.total_amount: Final total numeric amount on the receipt. Number only, no currency symbol. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
shared_fields.subtotal_amount: Subtotal before tax. Number only. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
shared_fields.tax_amount: Tax or service charge amount. Number only. May be labeled TAX, VAT, PB1, or other local tax codes. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
shared_fields.cash_amount: Cash paid by customer. Number only. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
shared_fields.change_amount: Change returned to customer. Number only. May use dot as thousands separator (e.g. 20.000 = 20,000). Extract the number as-is from the receipt text.
